6. My own pre-declared `last_gain_at_most(0.02)` rule fired on this negative gain, correctly blocking further tweaks (refine, pick) and forcing a stop.
7. Stopped on that trigger; the harness reverted to the best-so-far rule.

**Candidate submitted:** Rule **[Feature 32 long, Feature 35 short]** — a simple 2-feature equal-weight combination.
- In-sample Sharpe (all years equal): **0.483**
- In-sample Sharpe (recent years weighted): **0.546**
- Clearly superior to the baseline model (0.183 / 0.246)

**Prediction for unseen data:** mean Sharpe **0.30**, sd **0.25** — reflecting meaningful expected decay from in-sample to out-of-sample performance (typical for any selected rule), tempered by the fact this was a short, low-complexity search (only one productive extension, immediately stopped at the first sign of overfitting) rather than an extensive data-mining exercise.
